sources.title: qwen3-8B - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: In our experiments, we are using Qwen3-8B as the backbone model because of its grouped-query attention and long-context capabilities. The finetuning process was conducted in a supervised instruction-tuning fashion, where the model was finetuned to match target labels with user instructions for financial sentiment and news classification tasks.
